left.condition: a TLS 1.2 server negotiates TLS 1.1 or below

left.why_checkable: The application's cipher-suite registry and handshake negotiation can be checked for TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 support.

evidence.quote:
A TLS-compliant application MUST implement the TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
   [GCM] cipher suite and SHOULD implement the TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
   [GCM] and TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 [RFC8439] cipher suites (see
   Appendix B.4).

right.condition: in the absence of an application profile standard specifying otherwise
right.required_behavior: implement the signature_algorithms TLS extension
right.why_checkable: Extension registration plus generation and parsing paths can be checked for signature_algorithms support.

evidence.quote:
In the absence of an application profile standard specifying
   otherwise, a TLS-compliant application MUST implement the following
   TLS extensions:

   -  Supported Versions ("supported_versions"; Section 4.2.1)

   -  Cookie ("cookie"; Section 4.2.2)

   -  Signature Algorithms ("signature_algorithms"; Section 4.2.3)
